run_sbatch_experiment: run a slurm sbatch experiment with multiple moolib peers using the sbatch_experiment CLI
run_dry_sbatch_experiment: run a dry test of the sbatch experiment to preview the slurm command without submitting
get_address: get the broker address from SSH_CONNECTION env var or fall back to the local hostname
check_nfs: check if the current working directory is mounted on an NFS filesystem using statfs
check_broker_online: check if the moolib broker is online by connecting and sending a sync RPC call
